body:
I have been on some type of opiates for about 2 years now.
My husband and I ordered 100 pods from a place on the net. We weren't expecting anything but I have to say they are pretty surprising, the effects.
We started with 3 pods each, removing the seeds and stems then grinding the pods in an expresso grind powder. We proceeded to pour a cup of boiling water over the powder, covered for 15 min and added a small amount of sugar.
I noticed nothing. I waited an hour to make sure my body couldn't possibly OD, became impatient and grounded 9 pods, same drill as before. Within 45 min I noticed a had sweet strong high. It didn't come on like popping pills but it was very nice and lasted hours!
ENJOY!
